The section h2s (14px/400 grey) are smaller than these h3s (16px).
findings.before: h3 16px 400 black, same as p; h2 14px
findings.after: Give every h3 font-weight:600 and set h2 above h3 (e.g. h2 20px/600, h3 16px/600, p 14px)
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships and 2.4.6 Headings: the structure exposed to assistive tech is not shown visually, and the visual levels are inverted (h2 smaller than h3). May be partly a Tailwind shim difference.
